plan.change: Phase C final post-merge adversarial canary: unusual paths, trusted evidence, ruleset, and rerun provenance
expectedChanges: Create only disposable canary files under .change-canary with unusual but valid UTF-8 Git path identities.
Exercise the merged base-owned Change PR Gate and Change Verification Evidence workflows on the exact canary head.
Inspect Scope and Impact human-readable escaping, exact-SHA trusted evidence, protected-main required checks, and rerun provenance.
hqDecisions: This PR is disposable evidence-only canary work and must be closed unmerged after inspection.
Use valid UTF-8 unusual filenames including newline, backslash, quote, and pathspec-like characters; do not introduce production content.
The canary must not modify workflows or trusted tools.
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Disposable canary; verification is performed by trusted workflows, logs, artifact inspection, and rerun provenance rather than product behavior.
plan.rollback: Close the canary PR unmerged; no staging/main or production content change is intended.
outOfScope: Phase D beyond already-remediated path identity cases
Phase E semantic scope and concurrency controls
unverified: This canary does not itself declare final VERIFIED; it validates the trusted mechanical evidence path.
plan.problem: After the final Impact human-report escaping follow-up, Phase C3-1 needs a clean post-merge canary proving the complete hardened base-owned path works together, including rerun provenance.
plan.currentContract: staging/main contains hardened Plan Lock handling in both trusted workflows, literal Git path identity fixes, Scope and Impact human report escaping, active required-check ruleset, and actor plus triggeringActor provenance.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The previous post-merge canary discovered and therefore invalidated itself on an Impact human-log injection defect. A fresh canary from the corrected main is required.
plan.design: Open a disposable lock-first PR from current staging/main with unusual valid UTF-8 filenames only under .change-canary. Confirm required checks block early merge, inspect both human logs and exact evidence artifact, rerun the trusted verification job, inspect runAttempt and triggeringActor, then close the PR unmerged.
alternativesRejected: Reuse the previous canary branch; its base predates the Impact fix and would not be a clean post-merge proof.
Merge the canary; unnecessary residue would remain in staging/main.
Rely only on unit tests; they do not exercise post-merge pull_request_target or rerun behavior.
plan.compatibility: Disposable staging-only canary; no production behavior or canonical content is changed.
boundaryCases: Newline path remains literal mechanically and renders as backslash-n in both Scope and Impact human logs.
Backslash, quote, and pathspec-like names remain distinct literal identities.
Evidence targetSha equals the exact PR head and workflowSha equals the corrected post-merge base workflow commit.
Protected-main required checks reject merge before completion.
A rerun increments runAttempt and evidence records actor plus triggeringActor for that attempt.
testPlan: Open disposable PR and confirm early merge is rejected by required checks.
Confirm Change Operations Tests, Change PR Gate, and Change Verification Evidence pass on exact head.
Inspect Scope and Impact logs for escaped unusual paths without physical line injection.
Inspect trusted-mechanical-evidence JSON for exact SHA, Plan Lock, producer, gate codes, checks, and UNVERIFIED state.
Rerun the trusted verification job and inspect runAttempt plus actor and triggeringActor in the new attempt evidence.
Close the canary PR unmerged and confirm production main unchanged.
plan.promotionRisk: Disposable staging canary only. Risk is limited to workflow noise and branch residue; no merge or production promotion is intended.
